text:
jordan: Quick syncor the upcoming cross-vendor marketplace push: need final SKU names, regional embargo windows, and a compact fallback plan if any driver/firmware misses the ship date.
anya: I can manage the marketplace windows. Proposal: stagger publishes to reduce blast radius: NA Tue 09:00 PT, EMEA Tue 17:00 CET, APAC Wed 02:00 JST. Thoughts?
matt: Infra OK with stagger. We need canonical tag format today: propose `redwood/demo-YYYYMMDD/<region>/<model>-<variant>`. No `latest`.
bob_nvidia: Nvidia will expose `h200-std` and `h200-lowlat`. Driver bundle + sha by EOD tomorrow.
sara_amd: AMD: publishing `mi300-throughput` and `mi300-econ`. We'll include firmware notes.
emily_habana: Habana (B200) will provide `b200-gen2`. Blurb and perf caveat in thread by EOD.
zhang_qualcomm: QComm trial image `qc-edge-1` is lab-only. No public listing unless green.
leila: Marketing needs 1-line blurbs + short caveat per model for preview pages by Mon noon.
raj_si: SI note: installers need immutable image tags + `marketplace_sku` in manifest. Add `recommended_batch` for auto-mapping.
matt: I'll publish sample manifest in a small PR. Fields: `model`, `variant`, `driver_sha`, `marketplace_sku`, `region`, `recommended_batch`, `compat_mode`.
deploy-bot: build 6723 succeeded for redwood/demo-20260331/na/h200-std (sha: c0ffee) :white_check_mark:
anya: Fallback policy: if a vendor driver slips for a region, we publish `redwood/compatible-demo-YYYYMMDD/<region>/<model>` and mark it as `compat_mode` with perf deltas in release notes. Partners can still test.
bob_nvidia: Acceptable. We'll try to avoid slips; will post any changes here immediately.
sara_amd: Same from AMD. We'll provide delta numbers for compat images.
jordan: Action list: infra (matt) publish manifest PR; vendors post blurbs + driver shas; marketing (leila) produce preview; marketplace (anya) set windows; SI (raj) validate installer once PR lands. I'll compile a one-pager after PR merges. Please react in-thread to claim items. :thumbsup:
